item.title: A ‘Just Culture’ Must Be The Foundation Of Our Health Care System — Dr Musa Mohd Nordin & Prof Azizi Haji Omar
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

A Just Culture isn't about being soft, but being fair and systematic. item.title: Dzulkefly To Share ‘Formula’ To Fix 40% Doctor No-Shows For Permanent Posts
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad says he will announce a "formula" in the near future to address the nationwide 40% medical officer no-show rate for permanent posts. The attrition rate is highest when doctors transition from contract to permanent positions. item.title: Medical Officers Are Slaves Too — MO In Internal Medicine Department
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Besides housemen, medical officers are slaves too. MOs clerk patients, formulate the management plan, stabilise patients, and initiate investigations. The same MO continues to run the ward service. One MO may be responsible for 30 to 40 patients at a time. The post Medical Officers Are Slaves Too — MO In Internal Medicine Department appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: After 15 Years Of Training, This Is What A Subspecialist Doctor Earns In Malaysia — Physician
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Specialist doctors in government earn RM12k-RM16k a month after 15 years of training. Subspecialists don't get extra allowances. No doctor expects to become wealthy from public service. But fairness, professional recognition, and workforce planning matter.
